verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Advertising on channels 37 / 38 / 39 at configured Advertising Interval (random delay 0..10 ms).
All advertising PDU types — ADV_IND, ADV_DIRECT_IND, ADV_NONCONN_IND, ADV_SCAN_IND.
Extended advertising PDU types (BLE 5) — ADV_EXT_IND + AUX_ADV_IND + AUX_SYNC_IND + AUX_CHAIN_IND + AUX_SCAN_REQ + AUX_SCAN_RSP + AUX_CONNECT_REQ + AUX_CONNECT_RSP.
Passive vs active scanning; SCAN_REQ → SCAN_RSP handshake.
Connection establishment via CONNECT_IND / AUX_CONNECT_REQ; honor WinSize / WinOffset / Interval / Latency / Timeout / ChM / Hop / SCA.
Connection event scheduling — anchor recurrence at Connection Interval; T_IFS = 150 ± 2 µs.
Sequence Number / NESN — retransmission on CRC error, correct toggle on success.
Channel Selection Algorithm #1 sequential ring + Algorithm #2 BLE 5 deterministic permutation.
Channel Map update via LL_CHANNEL_MAP_IND — Instant honored.
Connection Parameter Update via LL_CONNECTION_UPDATE_IND or LL_CONNECTION_PARAM_REQ/RSP.
PHY Update procedure — LL_PHY_REQ/RSP/UPDATE_IND on all PHY combinations.
LE Data Length Extension — LL_LENGTH_REQ/RSP up to 251-octet payload.
Encryption via LL_ENC_REQ/RSP + LL_START_ENC_REQ/RSP — AES-CCM key + MIC verification.
LE Secure Connections pairing — ECDH P-256 + Numeric Comparison / Passkey / Just Works / OOB.
Authenticated payload via LL_PING_REQ/RSP.
Periodic Advertising — sync acquisition via Periodic Advertising Sync Transfer + scanning.
Direction Finding (BLE 5.1) — CTE TX + RX on AoA (1 µs slot) + AoD (1 µs and 2 µs slot).
LE Power Control (BLE 5.2) — LL_POWER_CONTROL_REQ/RSP/IND exchange + Path-Loss threshold events.
Connected Isochronous Streams (BLE 5.2) — CIG creation, LL_CIS_REQ/RSP/IND, BN / NSE / FT honored.
Broadcast Isochronous Streams (BLE 5.2) — BIG creation, BIS sync via BASE discovery.
Enhanced ATT (BLE 5.2) — multi-bearer ATT, per-bearer flow control + MTU.
Supervision Timeout — Link Layer drops to Standby on expiry.
Address types — Public / Random Static / Resolvable Private Address / Random Private Non-Resolvable.
GATT discovery + notification + indication + read / write.
ATT MTU exchange.
L2CAP CoC flow-controlled + credit-based modes.
SMP pairing failure cases — Passkey Entry Failed / Confirm Value Failed / DHKey Check Failed / Numeric Comparison Failed.
Direct Test Mode — all DTM commands at all 4 PHYs on all 40 channels with all test patterns.
fields.notes: Bluetooth Core v5.2 does not include a formal verification plan inside the document; the Bluetooth SIG operates a Bluetooth Qualification Process (BQP) backed by the Profile Tuning Suite (PTS) which encodes per-spec-section test cases. RF tests use Direct Test Mode (Vol 6 Part F). Categories above are derived from Volumes 1-7.
